install:
set -euo pipefail
if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | UV_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 sh
  sudo ln -sfn "${HOME}/.local/bin/uv" /usr/local/bin/uv
  sudo ln -sfn "${HOME}/.local/bin/uvx" /usr/local/bin/uvx
fi
# Install the CI matrix's Pythons, read from the workflow so there is one list.
pythons="$(sed -n 's/^ *python-version: *\[\(.*\)\] *$/\1/p' .github/workflows/ci.yml | tr -d '",')"
if [ -z "$pythons" ]; then
  echo "no python-version matrix found in .github/workflows/ci.yml" >&2
  exit 1
fi
uv python install $pythons
uv sync --locked --all-groups
